title: Robot Wars
description: Command an army of intelligent machines in a chess-style tactical battle for control of a power grid. Deploy your Mainframe, Mech Titan, Artillery Bots, Stealth Drones, Spider Bots, and Nano Swarms across an 8x8 circuit grid. Destroy enemy processors, capture power nodes, and accumulate 10 million energy units to achieve total system dominance.
learning_objectives: Develop computational thinking by planning optimal movement sequences across the grid
Practice resource allocation by balancing unit actions with power node acquisition
Learn positional strategy through controlling key data junctions and power cores
Build risk evaluation skills by weighing engagement odds against potential system losses
Understand the value of unit diversity and specialization in achieving complex objectives
Strengthen sequential planning by coordinating multiple bot types toward convergent victory conditions
how_to_play: Each turn you receive 2 Action Points (AP). Moving a bot costs 1 AP, and using a special ability costs AP as listed on the ability.
Bots move like chess pieces: Mainframe=King, Mech Titan=Queen, Artillery Bot=Rook, Stealth Drone=Bishop, Spider Bot=Knight, Nano Swarm=Pawn.
Engage enemy bots by moving onto their grid square to deal damage. Nano Swarms upgrade to Mech Titan when reaching the far edge of the grid.
Control power nodes by positioning your bots on them. Each node generates energy income every processing cycle.
Win by destroying the enemy Mainframe, controlling 3 or more power nodes, or accumulating 10 million energy units.
Use special abilities strategically: each bot class has two unique subroutines that can override the outcome of critical engagements.
objectives: Destroy the rival Mainframe to trigger an instant system shutdown victory
Control 3 or more power nodes for a grid dominance victory
Accumulate 10 million energy units through strategic power generation

storybook_pages.title: The Circuit Grid
storybook_pages.text: Two rival AI networks clash for control of a critical power infrastructure. The 8x8 circuit grid is studded with power cores, data centers, and charging stations — each a vital resource in the war for digital supremacy. Your objective: deploy your robotic forces, capture power nodes, and dismantle the enemy network before it overwhelms your systems.
storybook_pages.image_prompt: two armies of robots facing each other across a glowing 8x8 circuit board grid with power cores and data centers, neon blue and red lighting, cyberpunk digital art, dramatic perspective

storybook_pages.title: Your Robot Army
storybook_pages.text:
Mainframe (King) - Your central processor, if it falls your network collapses.
Mech Titan (Queen) - Massive combat robot with full directional capability.
Artillery Bot (Rook) - Heavy weapons platform firing in straight lines.
Stealth Drone (Bishop) - Cloaked diagonal infiltrator and saboteur.
Spider Bot (Knight) - Agile multi-legged unit with unpredictable L-shaped jumps.
Nano Swarm (Pawn) - Microscopic robot cloud that upgrades to Mech Titan!
storybook_pages.image_prompt: lineup of six different robot types from a massive mainframe computer to tiny nanobots, each with unique mechanical designs, holographic blueprint display style, glowing circuit lines, futuristic tech art

storybook_pages.title: Power Nodes
storybook_pages.text: The grid contains 6 critical power nodes: the Power Core provides raw energy, the Data Center processes intelligence, the Charging Station restores damaged units, the Sensor Array reveals enemy positions, the Forge manufactures reinforcements, and the Shield Generator protects your network. Control them to fuel your war machine!
storybook_pages.image_prompt: birds eye view of a glowing 8x8 circuit grid with six highlighted power nodes showing a lightning bolt power core, server rack, charging pod, radar dish, robotic forge, and force field generator, tron-style neon art

strengths.name: Network Boost
strengths.desc: Enhances processing power of adjacent bots, granting +1 ATK to each allied unit nearby

strengths.name: Threat Detection
strengths.desc: Advanced sensors detect all threats — cannot be caught off guard by stealth attacks

strengths.name: Passive Generation
strengths.desc: Generates +50K energy per cycle simply by remaining online and operational

weaknesses.name: Critical System
weaknesses.desc: Destruction means total network collapse — must be protected at all times

weaknesses.name: Immobile Architecture
weaknesses.desc: Can only reposition 1 grid square in any direction per processing cycle

weaknesses.name: Overheating
weaknesses.desc: If surrounded by enemy bots, takes 1 damage per cycle from thermal overload

abilities.name: Overclock
abilities.desc: Overclock all adjacent bots, boosting their attack power by +2 for 1 turn

abilities.name: System Scan
abilities.desc: Run a deep system scan to reveal all enemy bot abilities and subroutines

strengths.name: Omnidirectional Servos
strengths.desc: Advanced locomotion allows movement in any direction, any distance — most versatile unit

strengths.name: Heavy Caliber
strengths.desc: +2 ATK when engaging Spider Bots or Nano Swarms due to area-effect weapons

strengths.name: Magnetic Anchors
strengths.desc: Cannot be pushed or displaced by Stealth Drone abilities due to mass

weaknesses.name: Isolation Protocol
weaknesses.desc: -1 ATK if no allied bots within 2 grid squares for data sharing

weaknesses.name: Cooldown Required
weaknesses.desc: Each ability use costs +1 extra AP next cycle from system cooldown

weaknesses.name: Drive Oscillation
weaknesses.desc: Cannot remain stationary in the same grid cell for 2 consecutive cycles

abilities.name: Jet Boost
abilities.desc: Activate jump jets to teleport to any empty tile within 3 squares

abilities.name: Self-Repair
abilities.desc: Activate internal repair nanobots to restore +3 HP to hull integrity

strengths.name: Linear Targeting
strengths.desc: Fires in straight lines with unlimited range across the entire grid

strengths.name: Salvage Protocol
strengths.desc: +100K energy bonus when destroying any enemy bot and recycling components

strengths.name: Reinforced Plating
strengths.desc: Cannot be destroyed if adjacent to a controlled power node

weaknesses.name: No Diagonal Targeting
weaknesses.desc: Targeting systems cannot lock onto diagonal trajectories whatsoever

weaknesses.name: Power Drain
weaknesses.desc: Loses 1 HP per cycle if not adjacent to a power node for recharging

weaknesses.name: Minimum Firing Range
weaknesses.desc: Must reposition at least 2 grid squares when moving due to barrel length

abilities.name: Power Siphon
abilities.desc: Tap into any adjacent power node to extract energy income instantly

abilities.name: EMP Burst
abilities.desc: Fire an electromagnetic pulse weakening an enemy within 3 squares by -2 ATK

strengths.name: Diagonal Cloaking
strengths.desc: Moves along diagonals while cloaked for devastating surprise flanking attacks

strengths.name: Signal Jamming
strengths.desc: Enemies adjacent to Stealth Drone suffer -1 ATK from electronic interference

strengths.name: Chain Disruption
strengths.desc: Pushing an enemy bot into another enemy bot causes collision damage to both

weaknesses.name: No Linear Movement
weaknesses.desc: Cannot move horizontally or vertically — only diagonal movement circuits installed

weaknesses.name: Power Dependent
weaknesses.desc: -2 ATK if total energy reserves drop below 2 million

weaknesses.name: Fragile Chassis
weaknesses.desc: Takes +1 extra damage from Mech Titan attacks due to thin armor plating

abilities.name: Repulsor Field
abilities.desc: Activate a repulsor field to push an enemy bot 2 grid squares away

abilities.name: Translocate
abilities.desc: Swap positions with any friendly bot using quantum entanglement link

strengths.name: Multi-Leg Traversal
strengths.desc: Unique L-shaped movement that climbs over obstacles and bypasses enemy formations

strengths.name: Ambush Protocols
strengths.desc: +2 ATK when striking from an unexpected vector angle

strengths.name: Hardened Exoskeleton
strengths.desc: Takes -1 damage from all incoming attacks due to distributed armor plating

weaknesses.name: Predictable Patterns
weaknesses.desc: Only 8 possible landing positions — can be anticipated and countered

weaknesses.name: Servo Cooldown
weaknesses.desc: Cannot use abilities in consecutive cycles while servos recalibrate

weaknesses.name: Path Memory
weaknesses.desc: Cannot return to a previous grid position within 2 cycles due to pathfinding cache

abilities.name: Deploy Firewall
abilities.desc: Construct a digital firewall on any empty adjacent tile to block enemy movement

abilities.name: Overclock Servos
abilities.desc: Overclock leg servos for an immediate second move this processing cycle

strengths.name: Adaptive Code
strengths.desc: +1 ATK for each processing cycle survived, stacking up to +3 maximum

strengths.name: Swarm Tactics
strengths.desc: You deploy 8 Nano Swarms — overwhelm enemy defenses with sheer unit count

strengths.name: Upgrade Protocol
strengths.desc: Reaching the far edge of the grid triggers full upgrade to Mech Titan class

weaknesses.name: Forward Propagation Only
weaknesses.desc: Can only advance forward across the grid, never reverse direction

weaknesses.name: Minimal Shielding
weaknesses.desc: Only 3 HP — easily dispersed by any combat-class bot

weaknesses.name: Diagonal Engagement Only
weaknesses.desc: Can only attack enemies diagonally, not during forward propagation

abilities.name: Repair Swarm
abilities.desc: Detach repair nanobots to heal any adjacent allied bot +3 HP

abilities.name: Mesh Network
abilities.desc: Link with an adjacent friendly Nano Swarm and swap grid positions

glossary_terms.definition: The process of selecting among alternatives based on available information and values.
glossary_terms.example: Choosing between two career paths based on income, passion, and long-term growth.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Good decision-making combines rational analysis with awareness of cognitive biases that distort judgment.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Leaders make high-stakes decisions daily — the quality of their process matters as much as the decision itself.

glossary_terms.definition: Analyzing information objectively to form a well-reasoned judgment.
glossary_terms.example: Questioning whether a statistic is representative before using it to make a decision.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Critical thinking involves identifying assumptions, evaluating evidence, and considering alternative perspectives.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Journalists fact-check before publishing; scientists replicate experiments before claiming discoveries.

glossary_terms.definition: The belief that abilities can be developed through effort and learning from failure.
glossary_terms.example: Seeing a poor game result as feedback on what to practice, not evidence of being bad at the game.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Research by Carol Dweck shows people with growth mindsets achieve more and recover better from setbacks.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Students who believe intelligence is fixed give up when challenged; those with growth mindset persist and improve.
